elements.element: Vendor duty to defend and indemnify
elements.evidence: "TrueLink shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Client"

elements.element: Indemnified parties include Customer and its affiliates
elements.evidence: "Client and its affiliates, directors, officers, employees and agents"

elements.element: Third-party claims alleging services/deliverables infringe IP
elements.evidence: "an allegation that the Interface, the Hosting Services, the Support Services or any other materials or services provided by TrueLink infringe or misappropriate any copyright, patent, trade secret, trademark or other intellectual property right"

elements.element: Claims arising from Vendor's breach of law
elements.evidence: "TrueLink's violation of any applicable law, rule or regulation"
"any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content or Client Confidential Information caused by TrueLink"

elements.element: Vendor gross negligence or wilful misconduct
Standard indemnity procedure: notice, control of defence, cooperation
elements.evidence: No notice/control/cooperation mechanics appear in the redlined clause; new paragraph c ends at "gross negligence or willful misconduct."

elements.element: Customer's indemnity limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law
elements.evidence: Paragraph a is untouched and still covers "any claim arising out of any breach by Client of this Agreement" and "injury or damage to person or property caused by a product, service, or information ... transmitted from the Web Site"
"an allegation that the Interface, the Hosting Services ... infringe or misappropriate any ... intellectual property right"
No exclusions appear; only "to the extent arising out of" scoping language
No procure/modify/replace/refund remedy language in the inserted paragraph c

elements.element: Vendor indemnity subject to super-cap of 3x annual fees
elements.evidence: No cap language inserted anywhere in the clause

reasons: The inserted paragraph c captures four of the preferred triggers (IP infringement, breach of law, Vendor-caused data breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct) but omits the standard indemnity procedure (notice, Vendor control of defence, Customer cooperation) required by the preferred prose.

The preferred position also requires narrowing Customer's indemnity to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law; paragraph a is left untouched and still indemnifies TrueLink for any Client breach of the Agreement and for product/service injury claims, so the preferred level is incomplete.

Fallback is not satisfied either: no usual exclusions (Customer modifications, combinations, specifications), no procure/modify/replace/refund remedies, and no 3x annual fees super-cap. Preferred and fallback cannot be mixed.

Minimality fails: the insertion adds "hold harmless" language and indemnitees beyond Customer and affiliates ("directors, officers, employees and agents"), which exceed the preferred prose, consistent with the official precision checks.
